ready: Under a socio's name on its home page, when it has no instructions to show.
soul: Button that opens the socio's Soul: its character and instructions. "Soul" is a product noun.
settings: Button at the top of a socio's (AI agent's) home page, for its owner or an admin: opens the socio's settings.
new-chat: Button at the top of a socio's home page that starts a new chat with it.
team: Beside a chat in a list: it's a team conversation (shared with other people).
room: Beside a chat in a list: it's a room (a chat several people share). Product noun.
run.running: Each run.* key: A turn's status (a turn is one answer the socio worked on), before when it started.
run.finished: A turn's status beside its start time in the socio's turn panels: it finished. (Finished turns usually show no status.)
run.stopped: A turn's status beside its start time in the socio's turn panels: someone stopped it before it finished.
run.failed: A turn's status beside its start time in the socio's turn panels: it ended with an error.
run.interrupted: A turn's status beside its start time in the socio's turn panels: it was cut off before it finished.
archived.banner: Banner at the top of an archived socio's home page.
archived.unarchive: Button on the archived banner, for the socio's owner or an admin: makes the socio active again.
quiet.text: One line in place of the panels when the socio has nothing in progress, nothing waiting for the person and nothing scheduled.
quiet.links: Accessible name of the links after it (Approvals, Schedules, Board).
quiet.approvals: Link to the Approvals page, in the line shown when the socio has nothing going on.
quiet.schedules: Link to the Schedules page (scheduled tasks), in the line shown when the socio has nothing going on.
quiet.board: Link to the Improvements board, the workspace's list of feature requests and issues.
columns.now: The columns.* keys: Headings of the home page's three columns: what's happening now, what happened, what's planned.
columns.earlier: Heading of the home page column of what happened: archived chats and recent turns.
columns.next: Heading of the home page column of what's planned: the socio's upcoming scheduled work.
all: Button on a panel that shows the whole list below; count is how many there are.
panels.active: Heading of the panel of the socio's chats that aren't archived.
panels.active-empty: Empty Active chats panel; {{name}} is the socio's name. _archived: the socio is archived, so no new chat.
panels.running: Panel of the socio's turns still running.
panels.running-empty: Empty Running panel: no turn of this socio is in progress.
panels.load-failed: Shown in a panel when the socio's turns couldn't be loaded.
panels.archived: Heading of the panel of the socio's archived chats.
panels.recent: Panel of the socio's latest turns (answers it worked on).
panels.recent-empty: Empty Recent panel: the socio hasn't answered anything yet.
panels.nothing-planned: Shown in the Next column when nothing is scheduled for the socio.
chats.title: Heading of the section listing all chats with this socio, under its tabs.
chats.tabs: Accessible name of the Active and Archived tabs; {{name}} is the socio's name.
chats.active: Tab of the chats list: chats that aren't archived.
chats.archived: Tab of the chats list: archived chats.
chats.active-empty: Empty Active tab; {{name}} is the socio's name. _archived: the socio is archived.
chats.archived-empty: Empty Archived tab. {{name}} is the socio's name.
